name: FLIP Griffin-1
full_name: Venturi Astrolab FLIP (FLEX Lunar Innovation Platform) on Astrobotic Griffin-1
witness_expected: first sunset after Griffin-1 landing (NET Nov 2026)
note: Printed public numbers only. Store Wh, hibernation load W, and geometry OPEN. LPSC 1874 ties FLIP to VIPER launch-mass/geometry envelope (480 kg), not battery/solar/thermal heritage. Griffin PUG 1.0/2.5 W/kg and polar 'up to 14 days' are lander offer, not FLIP store.
electrical_model: Identity line, not ICES Fig.14 leak. usable_Wh / 354 h = hibernation load W. Store and load OPEN. 30% reserve on the example table is ASSUMED. Do not pick a store. Do not run Fourier leak without printed geometry and load.
witness_note: Griffin polar PUG surface thermal (−30°C to 80°C) 'does not include lunar night'; polar surface ops 'Up to 14 Days' is lander offer, not FLIP store.
killer_two_knobs: store Wh and hibernation load W both OPEN. usable_Wh / 354 h = hibernation load W. Example table uses ASSUMED 30% reserve on 1/2/5/10 kWh nameplates — not printed, not a picked store. Griffin PUG polar thermal excludes lunar night; 1.0/2.5 W/kg is lander offer, not FLIP store. VIPER battery not inherited (LPSC 1874 quotes launch-mass/geometry envelope only).
thermal_hold_md: No printed FLIP night hold T_box. LPSC 1874 names lunar hibernation in the CONOPS and 'thermal systems' as a characterization goal, without watts or kelvin. Astrolab FLIP page: Venturi battery enclosure 'store enough energy to survive the lunar night' — qualitative. Home: collapsible solar array charges the same full-size Venturi battery as FLEX. FLEX page prints enclosure withstand −90 to −230 °C as FLEX daily range — not mixed in as FLIP T_box. T_env OPEN: Paige 2011 below 23 K (PSR/polar floor, colder than Mons Mouton high point) and Williams 2019 110 K polar cold-trap contour (higher elevations less often below 110 K in summer). Neither is this rover's printed sink.
alloy_md: No printed FLIP structure alloy. OPEN. No NIST map. Fourier not run.
honesty_md: No printed FLIP Wh, hibernation W, solar W, or RHU. Do not pick a store. Do not copy VIPER 5420 Wh / 320 W arrays. Griffin lander has no night by PUG. 354 h is Cataldo/Mason darkness, not a Mons Mouton site-specific night length (none printed). 30% reserve on the identity table is ASSUMED.

mass_kg.quote: FLIP is a four-wheeled skid steer rover limited to the geometry and launch mass (480kg) initially designed for VIPER.
mass_kg.cite: LPSC 2026 1874: launch mass 480 kg (VIPER envelope). Not battery mass.

payload_capacity_kg.cite: Astrolab PR 2025-02-05: payload capacity of 30 kg.
payload_capacity_kg.page_or_figure: Additional background on the FLIP rover

store_Wh.page_or_figure: LPSC 1874; Astrolab FLIP/home — qualitative survive-the-night only
store_Wh.close_with: Printed FLIP nameplate or usable Wh. Do not inherit VIPER 5420 Wh. Do not pick 1/2/5/10 kWh from the ASSUMED table.

battery_nameplate_Wh.page_or_figure: FLIP page Venturi enclosure; home 'same full-size battery as FLEX'

P_keepalive_W.close_with: Printed FLIP hibernation / keepalive average W. Do not use Griffin PUG 1.0/2.5 W/kg as this rover's night load.

P_array_W.page_or_figure: home: collapsible solar array named, watts not printed
P_array_W.close_with: Printed FLIP array watts. Do not inherit VIPER 320/450 W panels. FLEX 3 m² is FLEX, not this box.

rhu.page_or_figure: Astrolab FLIP/home/PR — no RHU statement found 2026-09-17
rhu.close_with: Printed FLIP RHU count or a first-party statement that none is flown.

viper_battery_heritage_Wh.cite: OPEN — LPSC 1874 quotes VIPER launch-mass/geometry envelope only, not battery heritage.
viper_battery_heritage_Wh.page_or_figure: Vehicle Build and Test 480 kg envelope
viper_battery_heritage_Wh.close_with: A printed quote in LPSC 1874 (or later FLIP paper) tying FLIP's battery/solar/thermal subsystem to a VIPER number. Until then do not copy 5420 Wh.

H_night_h.cite: Cataldo & Mason, Survive and Operate Through the Lunar Night Workshop 2018 (LPI Contrib. 2106): 354 h of darkness. No Mons Mouton site-specific night length printed. PUG '354 hours' is a lunar day sunrise-to-sunset for Peregrine mid-latitude — not used as FLIP polar night.

T_box_C.close_with: Printed FLIP bus/pack night hold °C. Do not use FLEX enclosure −90/−230 °C as this box's hold.

T_box_K.close_with: Printed FLIP night hold K, or a printed °C to derive.

T_env_K.cite: OPEN — no printed Mons Mouton night sink for FLIP. Two printed polar bounds, no middle. Paige 'below 23K' is a PSR excursion (OPEN_below_printed), colder than a Mons Mouton high point. Williams 110 K is a polar cold-trap contour, not this rover's sink.
T_env_K.close_with: Printed FLIP/Mons Mouton night environment temperature of the rover as a single value.

bracket_lo.cite: Paige et al. 2011 LPI 6058 p.1: 'surface temperature excursions below 23K are briefly observed'. 23 K is the coldest printed number, not a floor — the paper says below. OPEN_below_printed. PSR/polar floor, colder than Mons Mouton high point — not this rover's sink. Annual average 'less than 38K' is not the cold bound.
bracket_lo.quote: surface temperature excursions below 23K are briefly observed

bracket_hi.label: Williams 2019 polar cold-trap contour — used as warm printed polar bound, not a box sink
bracket_hi.cite: Williams et al. 2019 JGR: surfaces below 110 K capable of cold trapping water; south-winter area ×2.8. Higher elevations have a low fraction of temperatures mapped below 110 K in summer. Not FLIP's printed sink.
bracket_hi.quote: surfaces below 110 K capable of cold trapping water over 1 Gyr increases by factors of 2.8 and 4.3 in the winter for the south and north polar regions, respectively

landing_site_name.cite: LPSC 2026 1874: Mons Mouton region of the lunar south pole. Aerospace America 2026-09-15: touch down at Mons Mouton. Dated 2025 PR said Nobile Region — not mixed; 2026 print used.

launch_NET.cite: Aerospace America 2026-09-15: Griffin launch no earlier than November 2026. Space.com 2026-06-15: late 2026. LPSC 1874 mid-2026 is older and superseded.

lander_polar_surface_ops_days.cite: Astrobotic PUG 2022 Griffin polar configuration: Surface Operations Duration Up to 14 Days. Lander offer, not FLIP night duration.

lander_payload_nominal_W_per_kg.cite: Astrobotic PUG 2022 POWER SERVICES: NOMINAL 1.0 W per kilogram of payload. Lander offer only, not FLIP store or hibernation load.

lander_payload_peak_W_per_kg.cite: Astrobotic PUG 2022 POWER SERVICES: PEAK 2.5 W per kilogram of payload as scheduled by Astrobotic. Lander offer only, not FLIP store.

lander_thermal_includes_night.quote: This range is relevant for the nominal lunar surface operations duration and does not include lunar night or missions to equatorial latitudes.
lander_thermal_includes_night.cite: Astrobotic PUG 2022 LUNAR SURFACE (−30°C TO 80°C) does not include lunar night. Griffin lander no night by PUG.

eps_eff.close_with: Printed FLIP radiator/MLI e*. Not LEMS 0.0028.

A_rad_m2.page_or_figure: PR names a radiator as a dust-coating target; area not printed
A_rad_m2.close_with: Printed FLIP radiator area. Do not use LuSEE 0.15 or LEMS declared 0.80.

L_path_m.close_with: Printed conductive length. Fourier not run while store and load are OPEN.

night_strategy.value: Venturi battery + collapsible solar array; lunar hibernation in CONOPS; lander has no night by PUG
night_strategy.cite: Astrolab home: Power to Survive the Lunar Night. FLIP page: enclosure stores enough energy to survive the lunar night. LPSC 1874: lunar hibernation in the operational concept. No printed hibernation watts. No RHU statement.
night_strategy.page_or_figure: Engineered for Extremes; LPSC 1874 Operational Concept

k_path.cite: FLIP structure alloy NOT PRINTED. Fourier not run. no measurement by us.
